title: The Camellia & The Bluestem - 2 homes, 8 bedrooms
description:
✨ Two homes, two rooftop patios, and room for everyone make The Camellia & The Bluestem the ultimate Nashville getaway. These side-by-side East Nashville townhomes offer 8 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms, spacious open-concept living areas, fully equipped kitchens, high-speed WiFi, and rooftop patios with skyline views. Just minutes from downtown and Broadway, they're perfect for family reunions, group getaways, celebrations, corporate retreats, and unforgettable Music City stays. 🌆

The space
Two Homes, One Unforgettable Experience

Book both The Camellia and The Bluestem to enjoy the privacy and comfort of two separate spaces, while still being conveniently located side by side. Unwind in beautifully designed interiors, savor rooftop cocktails beneath the starry Tennessee sky, and take full advantage of East Nashville’s vibrant dining, nightlife, and music scene—all just minutes from downtown Nashville.

What You’ll Love:
◆ Spacious side-by-side homes, each featuring bedrooms with private ensuite bathrooms.
◆ Prime Location just steps from Five Points & a quick ride to Downtown, Broadway, & the Ryman Auditorium.
◆ Spacious Rooftop Patios with cozy seating with firepit, dining table, cornhole, & skyline views.
◆ Fully-equipped Modern Kitchens with sleek appliances & essentials.
◆ Smart TVs in Living Rooms & several bedrooms – Log into your favorite streaming apps or cast from your phone.
◆ Central Heating & AC for year-round comfort.
◆ High-Speed Wi-Fi & Dedicated Workspaces.
◆ Garage parking available for four standard-size vehicles, plus ample street parking.
◆ Dog Friendly - $150 pet fee for up to 4 dogs. No breed or weight restrictions!

The Camellia

Welcome to The Camellia in East Nashville, just minutes from downtown. This modern 4-bedroom, 4-bath home offers stunning skyline views from the rooftop patio, complete with cozy seating and a firepit. The open-concept living area is perfect for spending quality time with family and friends. With high-speed internet, dedicated workspaces, and a fully equipped kitchen, this home combines style and functionality seamlessly.

Where you'll sleep at the Camellia: 
First Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 1 - Bunk Beds (Two Queens Below, Two Twins on Top) + Ensuite Full Bathroom
Second Floor:
◆ Bedroom 2 - King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom
Third Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 3 -  King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom & Twin Rollaway Bed
◆ Bedroom 4 - King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom

The Bluestem
https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1333531584222172060
Welcome to The Bluestem, hosted by Hallson Hospitality! Much like the plant it’s named after, The Bluestem blends rugged charm with a touch of elegance. Located in the vibrant East Nashville neighborhood and just minutes from downtown, this newly designed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers the perfect balance of modern style and comfort. With every detail thoughtfully curated, this home promises a memorable stay that combines convenience and style.

Where you'll sleep at the Bluestem:
First floor: 
◆ Bedroom 1 - Two sets of Queen Bunk Beds (4 Queen beds) + Ensuite Full Bathroom
Second (Main) floor: 
◆ Bedroom 2 - King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom
Third floor: 
◆ Bedroom 3 - King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom
◆ Bedroom 4 - King Bed + Ensuite Full Bathroom

About Hallson Hospitality 

At Hallson Hospitality, we take pride in being a locally owned company, offering a portfolio of thoughtfully designed properties that adhere to the highest standards of comfort and quality. Our team of hospitality professionals is dedicated to creating seamless and unforgettable experiences for each guest. 

From curated amenities to personalized service, we go the extra mile to ensure your stay is exceptional. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your visit, please don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your time with us truly unforgettable. To further elevate your stay, we offer a variety of Experience Add-ons, including early check-ins and late check-outs, private chefs, in-home massages, in-home yoga sessions, and more.

Pilates: 
Just a short drive away in the Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood is SŌLR Pilates, Nashville’s infrared hot mat Pilates studio. Guests staying in our homes receive 20% off studio classes and priority booking for private group sessions, perfect for bachelorette groups, birthdays, or a relaxing wellness experience during your stay.

Thank you for considering The Camellia & The Bluestem for your upcoming trip! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper right-hand corner, so it’s easy to find again – whether for this trip or a future stay.

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible.

Other things to note
These are two side-by-side homes, but there are no connecting doors between them.

Please note: Each home features three floors of interior living space, with the rooftop terrace located on the 4th floor. There are multiple flights of stairs throughout the home. The main living area and kitchen are located on the second floor, so guests should be comfortable navigating stairs during their stay.

This East Nashville neighborhood is evolving, with a mix of newly built homes as well as some charming older developments that reflect the vibrancy of the area. It’s a community on the rise, offering a unique blend of urban convenience and neighborhood charm.
